read.en: The Nasdaq ADS fell 4.3% on Nov 13 to $131.79, trading $129.18–135.76 on light volume (0.67x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($135.2), 10-day ($136.9) and 30-day ($149.1), all falling (no 100-day or 200-day yet, 90 sessions). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 12, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 5 ($161.05), and RSI is 41.7.
